verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an API-driven video-generation SaaS, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The documented REST APIs (Video, Upload, Billing, Localization) and the Synthesia MCP are developer building blocks or separate capabilities, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
